confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Perth price levels for July 2026 (winter, outside peak summer season); no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and vary with events and school holidays. USD values were estimated from approximate AUD price levels at roughly 0.70 USD per AUD. FX: the RBA observation could not be verified. Search results attributed a 16 October 2026 rate to the RBA, but a second search could not corroborate it, and I did not read the rba.gov.au page, so fx is null rather than an unverified rate and citation. The server should obtain the RBA F11 observation directly before relying on conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against other mid-sized Australian capitals with similar restaurant and accommodation levels (for example Adelaide and Brisbane), adjusted for Perth's typical premium on dining and hotel rooms relative to those cities.
